pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is a good use of your talents? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding them always
   B. Helping others with them
   C. Boasting about them
   D. Using them to hurt people

2. A classmate is sitting alone and looks sad. What should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore them
   B. Tell others to avoid them
   C. Laugh at them
   D. Sit with them and kindly ask what is wrong

3. Which is a result of a bad choice such as fighting? (1 mark)
   A. Better marks
   B. Getting a prize
   C. Injury and punishment
   D. More friends

4. Which question helps you to choose rightly? (1 mark)
   A. What is the cheapest?
   B. Who will laugh at me?
   C. Does this agree with what God teaches?
   D. Will I get away with it?

5. Which of these is a way of respecting family members at home? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting at siblings
   B. Ignoring instructions
   C. Greeting politely and helping with chores
   D. Refusing to share

6. Which Bible passage tells children to obey their parents in the Lord? (1 mark)
   A. Ephesians 6:1-3
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. John 3:16

7. Someone offers you sweets and asks you to keep a secret. What should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Ask for more
   B. Go with them
   C. Accept and hide it
   D. Refuse and tell a trusted adult

8. Which number can a child in Kenya call for help, as given in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. 300
   B. 100
   C. 116
   D. 555

9. Which verse says that God has engraved His people on the palms of His hands? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. Isaiah 49:16
   C. Genesis 1:27
   D. Luke 1:37

10. Who was told by an angel that they would have a son called Samson? (1 mark)
   A. His parents
   B. Ruth
   C. Joshua
   D. Balak

11. In which book of the Bible is the story of Samson found? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis
   B. Judges
   C. Luke
   D. Psalms

12. Why is Joseph a good example of leadership? (1 mark)
   A. He was lazy
   B. He was honest, wise and hardworking
   C. He was rude
   D. He was selfish

13. What did Jesus say made Bartimaeus well? (1 mark)
   A. His faith
   B. His shouting
   C. His money
   D. His cloak

14. What did Jesus say to the young man? (1 mark)
   A. Young man, I say to you, get up
   B. Go away
   C. Be quiet
   D. Follow me

15. What did Jesus pray on the cross? (1 mark)
   A. Father, take me away
   B. Father, punish them
   C. Father, send angels
   D. Father, forgive them

16. A classmate breaks your pencil by accident. What is the best response? (1 mark)
   A. Shout at him
   B. Tell others lies
   C. Forgive and accept the apology
   D. Break his pencil

17. Which of these is a physical need? (1 mark)
   A. A game
   B. A toy
   C. Food
   D. A loud radio

18. According to Acts 20:35, what is more blessed? (1 mark)
   A. To keep than to give
   B. To give than to receive
   C. To sleep than to work
   D. To buy than to sell

19. What is baptism? (1 mark)
   A. A dance
   B. A meal
   C. A journey
   D. A Christian act of washing with water in the name of Father, Son and Holy Spirit

20. What is a good way of obeying? (1 mark)
   A. Complain
   B. Refuse
   C. Do it at once and cheerfully
   D. Do it later

21. In which Gospel passage did Jesus bless little children? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 12:1
   B. Matthew 19:13-15
   C. John 3:1
   D. Acts 2:1

22. Which is school property? (1 mark)
   A. A pencil case
   B. Your lunch
   C. A desk
   D. Your shoes

23. What does the word holy mean? (1 mark)
   A. Famous
   B. Pure and set apart for God
   C. Old
   D. Rich

24. Why should a child tell a trusted adult if someone touches them wrongly? (1 mark)
   A. For no reason
   B. It is not their fault and the adult can protect them
   C. To boast
   D. To get someone in trouble

25. Why is the church called the house of God? (1 mark)
   A. It is a shop
   B. It is a school
   C. It is a holy place for worship
   D. It is a farm

26. Why did Jesus drive out the buyers and sellers? (1 mark)
   A. They were poor
   B. They were misusing God's house
   C. They were children
   D. They were noisy

27. What did Stephen pray for those stoning him? (1 mark)
   A. Punish them
   B. Send fire
   C. Take me away
   D. Lord, do not hold this sin against them

28. How many fruits of the Spirit are listed? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Five
   C. Twelve
   D. Nine

29. What does joy mean for a Christian? (1 mark)
   A. Having no problems
   B. Only laughing
   C. Deep gladness from knowing God
   D. Being rich

30. What is cyberbullying? (1 mark)
   A. Watching a lesson
   B. Sending hurtful messages to others
   C. Praying online
   D. Sharing kind words

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Describe how the ten lepers showed faith. (3 marks)

32. Explain what the healing of Bartimaeus teaches about Jesus. (3 marks)

33. Explain what Jesus taught in Matthew 5:38-39 and what this teaching does not mean. (5 marks)

34. Explain how a child can show appreciation for God's blessings, using what you learned about Abraham. (5 marks)

35. Explain how the story of Balaam teaches obedience to God and respect for those in authority. (5 marks)

36. Explain why Jesus cleared the temple. (3 marks)

37. Why is being joyful important for a Christian? Give three reasons. (3 marks)

38. Give four ways in which we can care for our eyes and health. (4 marks)

39. Explain what the parts of the parable stand for. (3 marks)

40. Give three examples of how a child can show self-control at school. (3 marks)

41. Explain how the books of the Old Testament are grouped, giving the number of books in each group. (5 marks)

42. Give three ways in which children can care for animals. (3 marks)

43. Outline three results of disobedience. (3 marks)

44. State two benefits of obeying parents. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Helping others with them
   Talents are gifts from God meant to serve others.

2. D — Sit with them and kindly ask what is wrong
   Kindness and listening help a sad friend.

3. C — Injury and punishment
   Fighting often brings pain, trouble and lost friendships.

4. C — Does this agree with what God teaches?
   We measure choices by God's word.

5. C — Greeting politely and helping with chores
   Polite words and helpful actions build peace at home.

6. A — Ephesians 6:1-3
   Ephesians 6:1-3 tells children to obey and honour their parents.

7. D — Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   Gifts with secrets are a warning sign.

8. C — 116
   Childline Kenya can be reached free on 116.

9. B — Isaiah 49:16
   Isaiah 49:16 uses this picture to show that God does not forget us.

10. A — His parents
   The angel of the Lord appeared to Samson's parents.

11. B — Judges
   Judges 13-16 tells about Samson.

12. B — He was honest, wise and hardworking
   These qualities helped him to lead Egypt well.

13. A — His faith
   Jesus said, "Your faith has healed you."

14. A — Young man, I say to you, get up
   Luke 7:14 records this command.

15. D — Father, forgive them
   Luke 23:34 records this prayer.

16. C — Forgive and accept the apology
   Forgiveness restores friendship.

17. C — Food
   Food, water, clothing and shelter are physical needs.

18. B — To give than to receive
   Acts 20:35 quotes Jesus' words.

19. D — A Christian act of washing with water in the name of Father, Son and Holy Spirit
   Baptism is a sign of new life.

20. C — Do it at once and cheerfully
   Obey promptly and willingly.

21. B — Matthew 19:13-15
   Matthew 19:13-15 records it.

22. C — A desk
   A desk belongs to the school.

23. B — Pure and set apart for God
   Holy means pure and set apart.

24. B — It is not their fault and the adult can protect them
   Telling keeps children safe.

25. C — It is a holy place for worship
   Believers meet there to worship God.

26. B — They were misusing God's house
   The temple was for prayer, not trading.

27. D — Lord, do not hold this sin against them
   Acts 7:60.

28. D — Nine
   There are nine.

29. C — Deep gladness from knowing God
   Joy comes from God.

30. B — Sending hurtful messages to others
   Bullying can happen online.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: They called out to Jesus; they obeyed His command to go to the priests before they were healed; one returned to give thanks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus has power over sickness. He cares about the poor and those who suffer. He responds to faith.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

33. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jesus taught that we should not repay evil with evil but respond with peace. It does not mean we must stay in danger or let people harm us. If someone keeps hurting us, we should tell a trusted adult who will protect us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not repaying evil with evil, 1 for peace, 1 for not staying in danger, 1 for telling a trusted adult, 1 for a clear explanation.

34. (5 marks)
   Answer: Abraham received God's blessings and passed them on. A child can thank God in prayer for family, food, health and school, share with others, obey God, and be a blessing as Abraham was told to be.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for blessings to Abraham, 1 for thanking God, 1 for examples of blessings, 1 for sharing, 1 for obeying or being a blessing.

35. (5 marks)
   Answer: God told Balaam what to say and do, and Balaam had to obey even though a king offered rewards. We should obey God's word and instructions from parents and teachers when they are good and right. Disobeying can put us in danger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's instruction, 1 for the reward temptation, 1 for obedience to God, 1 for obeying parents and teachers, 1 for danger of disobedience.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: The temple was meant for prayer but people used it to make money and cheat. Jesus cared for the honour of His Father's house.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for prayer purpose, 1 for making money or cheating, 1 for honour of God's house.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: It keeps us healthy in mind; it cheers others; it helps us face problems; it shows trust in God. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep hands clean; do not read in dim light; go to the clinic when eyes hurt; eat vegetables and fruit; rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: The woman stands for God; the coin stands for a lost person; the joy stands for the joy in heaven when someone repents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid part.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wait for your turn, do not fight, do homework first, do not shout, do not copy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.

41. (5 marks)
   Answer: Law has 5 books, history has 12 books, poetry and wisdom has 5 books, and the prophets have 17 books. Together they make 39 books.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each group with number, and 1 mark for the total.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Give them food and water; protect them from harm; do not beat them; do not overload them; give them shelter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Punishment, danger, loss of trust, guilt, poor marks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each result.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Pleases God, peace at home, trust from parents, learning good habits.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid benefit.
